### Fixed
- **atelet no longer evicts the cluster's workloads: `substrate.atelet.priorityClass.preemptionPolicy: Never` and `components.substrate{,-crds}.versionRange` is `>=1.1.3 <1.2.0`** (giantswarm/agent-platform#731). atelet ran on the PriorityClass `ate-node-critical` (value `1000000000`, `PreemptLowerPriority`), so a first enable over nodes without room for its 50m CPU / 128Mi evicted whatever the cluster already ran: monitoring, admission webhooks. The Substrate line's 1.1.3 takes the policy (giantswarm/substrate#87) and renders the non-preempting class under its own name, `ate-node-critical-non-preempting`, because a PriorityClass's `preemptionPolicy` is immutable. atelet keeps its priority and schedules ahead of every other pending pod, but it evicts nothing and stays Pending on a full node until capacity arrives. `make verify-components` asserts the forwarded value. The upgrade rolls atelet once onto the new class. The kagent WorkerPool's worker image follows the floor to `ateom-gvisor:1.1.3`.
